muxt generate --use-datastar --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /page Page(ctx)" -}}
{{- $base := .Actions.Save 7 -}}
<i data-on:click="{{ $base | .JS }}"></i>
<b data-on:click="{{ $base.OpenWhenHidden true | .JS }}"></b>
<u data-on:click="{{ ($base.Selector "#out").RetryInterval 500 | .JS }}"></u>
<s data-on:click="{{ $base | .JS }}"></s>
{{- end -}}
{{- define "POST /save/{id} Save(ctx, id)" -}}ok{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server reuses one base action with different delivery options: the setters
// are copy-on-write, so option chains never mutate the base.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Page(_ context.Context) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (Server) Save(_ context.Context, id int) (string, error) { return "", nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/page", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	for tag, want := range map[string]string{
		"i": `<i data-on:click="@post(&#39;/save/7&#39;)"></i>`,
		"b": `<b data-on:click="@post(&#39;/save/7&#39;, {openWhenHidden: true})"></b>`,
		"u": `<u data-on:click="@post(&#39;/save/7&#39;, {selector: &#39;#out&#39;, retryInterval: 500})"></u>`,
		"s": `<s data-on:click="@post(&#39;/save/7&#39;)"></s>`,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the %s render %q", body, tag, want)
		}
	}
}
